source.title: Core Rulebook spell support for APG Oracle mysteries

spells.name: Magic Vestment
spells.summary: Grant armor or a shield an enhancement bonus.

spells.name: Righteous Might
spells.summary: Grow larger and gain combat bonuses, natural armor, and damage reduction.

spells.name: Slay Living
spells.summary: Make a deadly touch attack that deals severe damage, reduced by a successful Fortitude save.

spells.name: Summon Monster V
spells.summary: Summon one or more extraplanar creatures to fight for you.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.summary: Remove fatigue or reduce ability damage.

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.summary: Restore life to a recently slain creature while healing damage.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.summary: Remove severe afflictions, ability drain, and negative levels.

spells.name: Mass Heal
spells.summary: Channel powerful healing among multiple creatures.

spells.name: True Resurrection
spells.summary: Restore a dead creature fully to life without requiring its body.

spells.name: Owl's Wisdom, Mass
spells.summary: Grant several creatures an enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
